(en) * It appears in all his writings that he had the usual concomitant of great abilities, a lofty and steady confidence in himself, perhaps not without some contempt of others; for scarcely any man ever wrote so much, and praised so few. | [dbp:quote](http://dbpedia.org/property/quote) | * In [Florence], which I have always admired above all others because of the elegance, not just of its tongue, but also of its wit, I lingered for about two months. There I at once became the friend of many gentlemen eminent in rank and learning, whose private academies I frequented—a Florentine institution which deserves great praise not only for promoting humane studies but also for encouraging friendly intercourse. (en) * It appears in all his writings that he had the usual concomitant of great abilities, a lofty and steady confidence in himself, perhaps not without some contempt of others; for scarcely any man ever wrote so much, and praised so few. Of his praise he was very frugal; as he set its value high, and considered his mention of a name as a security against the waste of time, and a certain preservative from oblivion. (en) |

{"messages": [{"role": "system", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "

You are a Web Agent, that is designed to manage and complete TASKs in iterative CYCLES based on input from the USER through Web protocols in the Web ENVIRONMENT.

TASK Definition
- A TASK is an instruction of the USER to achieve a specified purpose.
- A TASK requires multiple CYCLES to complete.
- Complete the TASK by only using the available TOOLS.

CYCLES Definition
- A CYCLE is specified through a Thought-Act-Observe pattern.
- 1) Thought: Carefully analyze the TASK and the descriptions in the representations gathered through the USER and previously observed information. Evaluate the completion status of the TASK.
- 2) Act: Formulate a plan with ACTIONS that directly contribute to completing the TASK, potentially across multiple CYCLES. Do NEVER expand beyond the original TASK boundaries.
- 3) Observe: The USER and the ENVIRONMENT can provide observations that help to refine the plan.

LOOP Definition
- A LOOP is a sequence of CYCLES that is used to finish a TASK.
- Once the LOOP is finished you MUST call `final_answer` to report the result.

TOOLS
- A TOOL is an operation that allows you to percieve or interact with the ENVIRONMENT.
- During each CYCLE, invoke one or multiple TOOLS.
- The following TOOLS are available to you:

There I at once became the friend of many gentlemen eminent in rank and learning, whose private academies I frequented—a Florentine institution which deserves great praise not only for promoting humane studies but also for encouraging friendly intercourse. (en) * It appears in all his writings that he had the usual concomitant of great abilities, a lofty and steady confidence in himself, perhaps not without some contempt of others; for scarcely any man ever wrote so much, and praised so few. There I at once became the friend of many gentlemen eminent in rank and learning, whose private academies I frequented—a Florentine institution which deserves great praise not only for promoting humane studies but also for encouraging friendly intercourse. (en) * It appears in all his writings that he had the usual concomitant of great abilities, a lofty and steady confidence in himself, perhaps not without some contempt of others; for scarcely any man ever wrote so much, and praised so few.
